Entities / Characters / Crissdalynn Khinriss

Crissdalynn Khinriss

Fourteen. Blue-black iridescent feathers. Geometric leatherwork armor. Chart satchel. Talons. Flies.

Irreverent and light until the fight starts. First three seconds of combat: friends, exit, weak point — in that order, without thinking.

DM Note

Whose opinion matters: Delmar Fisk. He is the fixed point. If someone threatens him, everything stops. She pulled him from the crow’s nest as the Maw closed and flew them both through thirty feet of solid water.

Backstory

Was mapping the Drowned Maw for Master Kyzil when the Red Lady went down. The task was consequence and calling both — she’d been goofing off at the High Eyrie and was cast out at 14, not for malice but for not taking her craft seriously. The mapping was the assigned price.

The timeline source states her banishment is permanent until the Drowned Maw task is complete. She served aboard the Red Lady for one year and ten months before the fleet sank.

The mapping is incomplete. She knows it.

The wound: The monastery banishment. It’s why the wreck matters more than it otherwise would. Not the direct cause — but the context that makes it load-bearing.

What She Wants

  • Says: Kyzil’s approval. Finish the Maw mapping. Kinship with the monastery that cast her out.
  • Actually: To be let back in. The banishment is still open.
  • Core belief: Shiny things are valuable regardless of what they actually are. She has said this aloud.
  • Red line: Will not turn her back on those she is loyal to.

Gear

  • Crystal dreidel from Kyzil — casts rainbows in sunlight; in her pocket
  • Satchel of charts

Mechanics

Class: Monk (Kensei) 4 | Background: Acolyte / Cartographer

Species: Aarakocra

Tactical note: No darkvision. Jean-Claude’s darkness features (invisibility, advantage) are a liability for her — she is blinded and at disadvantage in magical darkness. Party coordination required when managing light.

Gods: Remnis (primary). Syranita and Aerdrie Faenya in the margins. Wears it lightly; prays from habit, not theology.

Read the Current (Kensei technique, taught by Kyzil): Once on her turn when she hits a creature with an unarmed strike or Kensei weapon, she can spend 1 ki/focus point to read the target through the contact. Cannot combine with Stunning Strike or Deft Strike on the same hit. Choose one question; DM answers truthfully using combat-observable information:

  • Guard: What is this creature relying on most for defense right now — armor, agility, toughness, will, magic, distance, or terrain?
  • Opening: Which saving throw appears easiest to pressure — STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, or CHA?
  • Pattern: What is one combat habit the creature is relying on right now — counterattacks, reach, mobility, guarding an ally, protecting an object, concentration, brute force, or escape?

No exact numbers, full statblocks, secret identity, hidden lore, or motives. Repeating on the same creature should reveal a different category or deeper version, not the same fact again.

Relationships

  • Delmar Fisk — fixed point; sole co-survivor of the Red Lady; his opinion is the one that matters
  • Master Kyzil — mentor; approval-chase; gifted her the crystal dreidel
  • Perrin Black-Jaw — party
  • Jean-Claude Tabarnack — party; his darkness features are a tactical liability for her (no darkvision); she is a crow — he has a genetic terror of birds
  • High Eyrie — monastery; trained here; cast out at 14
  • Red Lady — ship that sank at the Drowned Maw; she flew Fisk clear
  • The Drowned Maw — her incomplete mapping task

Session Events

  • Session 01 — Dragged Cap’n Gorgeous through Perrin’s Minor Illusion to conceal the engagement; breached the weather deck when Delmar launched her through the hatch; redirected Grung toxin gas with Gust.
  • Session 02 — Deflected Rook’s flintlock shot; blocked Perrin before he killed Ket; let Ket feed on Rook’s men.
  • Session 03 — Caught Perrin and JC in their rigging fall from the crow’s nest. Flew out over the water and lifted a 60-ft whip shark clean out of the sea (contested strength; shark nat 1). Dug through Rook’s chart archive — found he broke Imperial rules about the Drowned Maw twice and kept no record of what he found. Tried to scout Calveno from above; too many people, gave up. Reunited with Master Kyzil in Le Paludi streets — he dove from the sun. Broke down.
  • Session 04 — Sparred Kyzil on the Ponte Bassa rooftop. Grappled him R1 (Kyzil rolled nat 1 on contested check); Kyzil acknowledged her growth. Activated tattoo for 15ft reach. Deflected 13 damage and redirected it (Kyzil saved). Fell off the roof from Kyzil’s Downburst — Kyzil panicked and flew down to catch her. Vouched for Jean-Claude to Kyzil. Kyzil told her the pilgrimage was the hardest in Eyrie history. Clotheslined the second patrol Grung in the sewers. Kingfishered the fleeing purple Grung at 45ft fly speed — dove from altitude, grappled with talons, shrugged off the spear hit and poison (Hero’s Feast immunity). Delivered the captive to the party. Leg-swept Delmar the next morning for going to Umberlee without her: “My burden was to carry you out of that stupid water.” Flew ~100ft over Calveno looking for Kyzil — couldn’t spot him.
